about: Catalogue of LibreLane (Classic flow, pinned commit) settings that make sense to vary in a DSE study.
Every name, type and choice is validated against configs/librelane_variables.json (scripts/variants.py check, tests).
Baseline values (C0) are the PDK's own LibreLane defaults, written out in configs/platforms.json, plus configs/defaults.json.
status=default: used when a plan selects knobs by group. status=opt_in: only used when named explicitly (and allow_opt_in for flagged ones).
levels: discrete values for ofat/factorial plans. range: bounds for latin-hypercube (lhs) plans.
Level forms: a plain value; {"$scale": x} relative to the lower layers (e.g. the calibrated clock of each design x PDK);
{"$of": [KEY, r]} = r x final KEY (e.g. a slack margin as a fraction of the clock period);
{"$rows": n} = n standard-cell row heights, converted per PDK from platforms.json reference.row_height_um
(sky130A 2.72, gf180mcuD 3.92, ihp-sg13g2 3.78 um) so geometric knobs mean the same thing on every PDK;
{"$value": v, "$with": {...}} = a level that also sets companion keys (e.g. padding raises density as LibreLane's own formula does).
Range options: relative (=$scale), of (=$of), unit: row_height_um (=$rows), scale: log, integer.
requires: prerequisites added automatically. effective_pdks: the knob only acts on these PDKs (generator prints a note).
Noise policy: the ONLY intentional random intervention is the initial global-routing seed. Knobs flagged uncontrolled_randomness
add another unseeded random source and are blocked unless a plan sets allow_opt_in.

groups.constraints: Timing target and interface assumptions (change the problem, not only the flow)
groups.synthesis: Yosys/ABC logic synthesis and technology mapping
groups.resizer: OpenROAD resizer: design repair and timing optimisation
groups.global_routing: FastRoute global routing and antenna repair

CLOCK_PERIOD.why: Timing pressure, relative to the calibrated reference of each design x PDK (scripts/calibrate_clock.py), so x0.8 means '20% tighter than that design's comfortable target' on every PDK. Most timing knobs only matter when timing is tight.

IO_DELAY_CONSTRAINT.why: Percent of the period reserved for external I/O paths (PDK default 20 on all three). Changes the specification, so opt-in.

CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_CONSTRAINT.why: Setup/hold guard band (PDK default 0.25 ns on all three). A specification choice, so opt-in.

MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT.why: Fanout limit for synthesis buffering and design repair (PDK default 10 on all three); trades buffers/area for slew and delay.

SYNTH_STRATEGY.why: ABC mapping script: the main area/delay trade-off in synthesis.

SYNTH_HIERARCHY_MODE.why: Flattening: cross-boundary optimisation vs preserved hierarchy.

SYNTH_SIZING.why: Gate sizing in ABC (otherwise left to the resizer).

SYNTH_ABC_DFF.why: Let ABC optimise across flip-flops (sequential optimisation).

SYNTH_ABC_USE_MFS3.why: Experimental SAT-based remapping in area scripts.

SYNTH_ABC_AREA_USE_NF.why: Use the &nf delay-oriented mapper inside AREA scripts.

SYNTH_ABC_LEGACY_REFACTOR.why: Legacy refactor command in ABC scripts.

SYNTH_ABC_LEGACY_REWRITE.why: Legacy rewrite command in ABC scripts.

SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES.why: Yosys resource sharing (merging mutually exclusive operators).

SYNTH_DIRECT_WIRE_BUFFERING.why: Insert buffers on direct input-to-output wires.

SYNTH_ADDER_TYPE.why: Adder mapping. Only sky130A ships FA/RCA/CSA maps at the pinned PDK versions (LibreLane deletes them for gf180mcu; IHP provides none), so elsewhere the variant equals the baseline. Relevant for SHA-256 (modular adders), ~irrelevant for AES/PRINCE.

SYNTH_MUL_BOOTH.why: Booth multiplier mapping. Only meaningful for designs with multipliers.

FP_CORE_UTIL.why: Core utilisation (LibreLane default 50): die/core size, hence area, wirelength and routability. The 65% level also raises density to 75 so placement stays feasible.

FP_ASPECT_RATIO.why: Core height/width; affects wirelength and pin access.

IO_PIN_PLACEMENT_MODE.why: Pin-placement algorithm. These modes use OpenROAD ioPlacer's internal fixed seed: not varied by the study, but verify determinism with a same-seed repeat before trusting them.

PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT.why: Global-placement density target (C0 60 = LibreLane's automatic value at utilisation 50): spreading vs wirelength. Must stay at least FP_CORE_UTIL + 5*GPL_CELL_PADDING + 5 (config_constraints).

PL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN.why: Routability-driven global placement (cell inflation in congested regions).

GPL_CELL_PADDING.why: Global-placement padding in sites per cell side (PDK default 0 on all three). Each level raises density by 5 per site, exactly as LibreLane's automatic density formula does, so the variant stays placeable.

DPL_CELL_PADDING.why: Detailed-placement padding in sites (PDK default 0 on all three): local whitespace for routing and repair.

PL_OPTIMIZE_MIRRORING.why: Cell mirroring optimisation in detailed placement.

DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_SLEW_PCT.why: Slew margin for post-GPL design repair.

DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_CAP_PCT.why: Capacitance margin for post-GPL design repair.

PL_RESIZER_SETUP_SLACK_MARGIN.why: Extra setup slack the post-CTS resizer aims for (LibreLane default 0.05 ns). Expressed as a fraction of the clock period because periods differ by ~3x across PDKs.

PL_RESIZER_HOLD_SLACK_MARGIN.why: Extra hold slack (ns) the post-CTS resizer aims for (LibreLane default 0.1 ns). Hold depends on clock skew and min delays rather than the period, so absolute ns are kept.

PL_RESIZER_SETUP_MAX_BUFFER_PCT.why: Cap on buffers added for setup repair (percent of instances).

RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR.why: Design repair after global routing. LibreLane marks it experimental (possible hangs).
RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR.caution: reroutes_unseeded: re-runs global routing with OpenROAD's default seed, partly overwriting the study seed's effect.

RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING.why: Timing repair after global routing. LibreLane marks it experimental (possible hangs).
RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING.caution: reroutes_unseeded: re-runs global routing with OpenROAD's default seed, partly overwriting the study seed's effect.

CTS_CLK_MAX_WIRE_LENGTH.why: Maximum clock wire length before buffering (LibreLane default 0 = unlimited), in row heights per PDK.

CTS_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_BUFFERS.why: Buffer spacing for clock wire segments (LibreLane default 0 = automatic), in row heights per PDK.

CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_ENABLE.why: Cluster clock sinks before building the tree.

CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_MAX_DIAMETER.why: Maximum sink-cluster diameter (LibreLane default: OpenROAD automatic), in row heights per PDK.

CTS_APPLY_NDR.why: Double-spacing non-default rule on clock nets: crosstalk/robustness vs routing resources.

CTS_BALANCE_LEVELS.why: Balance the number of clock-tree levels.

GRT_ADJUSTMENT.why: Global capacity reduction: congestion margin vs available routing resources.

GRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_ITERS.why: Antenna repair iterations after global routing.

GRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_MARGIN.why: Margin (%) when deciding which nets need antenna repair.

GRT_ALLOW_CONGESTION.why: Continue despite global-routing overflow. Changes what counts as a failure, so it is opt-in.

RUN_ANTENNA_REPAIR.why: Disable antenna repair. Opt-in: tends to create antenna violations rather than explore a trade-off.

DRT_OPT_ITERS.why: TritonRoute optimisation iterations (runtime vs DRC cleanliness).

DRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_ITERS.why: Antenna repair iterations inside detailed routing.

RUN_HEURISTIC_DIODE_INSERTION.caution: uncontrolled_randomness: LibreLane's odbpy/diodes.py uses Python random.random() without a seed to choose diode sides, so runs are not reproducible.

DIODE_ON_PORTS.caution: uncontrolled_randomness: same unseeded odbpy/diodes.py code path as heuristic insertion.

excluded.RT_MIN_LAYER, RT_MAX_LAYER, RT_CLOCK_*_L: Layer names are PDK-specific. Vary them with {"$per_pdk": {...}} in a hand-written variant if needed.
excluded.PDN_*: Power grid geometry is PDK-specific and mostly a robustness/IR-drop choice rather than a QoR knob.
excluded.MAX_TRANSITION_CONSTRAINT, MAX_CAPACITAN: Units and sensible values depend on the PDK library; use $per_pdk if needed.
excluded.RUN_*_DRC, RUN_LVS, RUN_*_STREAMOUT, RUN: Sign-off checks, not optimisation knobs. Turning them off weakens the pass criteria.
excluded.DRT_THREADS, STA_THREADS: Fixed by configs/study.json execution.threads for comparability.
excluded.PL_SKIP_INITIAL_PLACEMENT, PL_MIN/MAX_PH: Convergence/legalisation rescue settings; vary only to fix specific failures.
